headline: Good morning — Wall Street's AI-driven sell-off is only partly reversed and the RBA has reportedly lifted the cash rate to 4.85%, while Salesforce adds Cresta to its run of deals.

highlights.label: RBA hike
highlights.text: The RBA reportedly raised the cash rate 25 basis points to 4.85% on 3 November, its fifth rise this year; single-source, unconfirmed.

highlights.label: Wall St rebound
highlights.text: Nasdaq rose 1.09% on Friday after Thursday's steep AI sell-off, while the Dow slipped 0.46%.

highlights.label: Salesforce buys Cresta
highlights.text: Salesforce agreed to acquire voice AI firm Cresta, its third deal in two weeks, reportedly valued near US$2.7 billion.

tip.title: Drink a glass of water with each meal
tip.body: Tying hydration to something you already do makes it easy to remember. Keep a bottle at your desk and refill it at set points in the day, such as before meetings. Pale yellow urine is a simple everyday sign you are drinking enough.

quote.text: A journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step.
quote.author: Lao Tzu

items.title: Salesforce to buy Braze for about US$5.66 billion
items.summary: Salesforce announced on 20 October a deal to acquire Braze, which still needs stockholder and regulatory approval. Marketing Cloud and Braze customers should keep using current documentation until formal integration or licensing changes are published.

items.title: Adobe puts its CX Enterprise Coworker inside other AI assistants
items.summary: Adobe made the agent available as a plugin in ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Microsoft Copilot and Databricks Genie on 4 November. No pricing or adoption figures were disclosed.

items.title: HubSpot retires Design Manager serverless functions and older Node.js support
items.summary: HubSpot announced on 3 November that it is sunsetting Design Manager serverless functions and an older Node.js runtime. Teams relying on custom-coded modules should check for needed migration work.

items.title: Bloomreach adds native WhatsApp and transactional SMS triggers
items.summary: Bloomreach launched native WhatsApp integration and API-triggered transactional SMS around 6 November. It gives marketers more messaging channels inside one platform.

items.title: Adobe Journey Optimizer adds token resolution for AEM Content Fragments
items.summary: Adobe Journey Optimizer gained limited-availability support on 5 November for resolving personalisation tokens directly in Content Fragments. It should reduce workarounds for personalised content.

items.title: Salesforce agrees to acquire voice AI company Cresta
items.summary: Salesforce signed a definitive agreement to buy Cresta, with closing expected in the first quarter of its fiscal 2028 subject to approvals. Terms were not disclosed by Salesforce; one report puts the price at US$2.7 billion.

items.title: Third acquisition in two weeks after Rune and Braze
items.summary: Cresta follows the Rune Technologies and Braze deals, signalling an aggressive buying spree. Cresta's voice agents are expected to run as Agentforce agents on Data 360 profiles.

items.title: Salesforce launches Koa Decisions model
items.summary: Koa Decisions is the next version of the HyperClassifier decision model and makes classification decisions in a single step within milliseconds. It targets faster, cheaper agent decisions than full reasoning models.

items.title: Agentforce Coworker usage and reach grow
items.summary: Salesforce's newsroom lists Agentforce Coworker usage up 21 times in three months, with more than 185,000 users. Coworker was also reported to be expanding to Microsoft Teams and mobile on 4 November.

items.title: Salesforce shares slip despite buyback and revenue growth
items.summary: The article cites Q2 revenue of US$11.345 billion, up 10.8%, and a US$25 billion buyback, with shares down about 6% over the week. The commentary is opinion rather than company news.

sfstatus.statusNote: Status page could not be read directly; trackers showed no active major incident, with the last logged incident resolved on 31 October.

items.title: Experience Cloud LWR rendering incident resolved after more than a week
items.summary: Salesforce resolved a prolonged Experience Cloud rendering problem. No AU-specific Marketing Cloud or Data Cloud outage or planned maintenance was found; check status.salesforce.com.

items.title: RBA reportedly lifts cash rate to 4.85%
items.summary: The board reportedly voted six to three for a 25 basis point rise, the fifth this year. Not independently confirmed against the RBA statement.

items.title: Marles says suburbs are the wrong place for data centres
items.summary: The deputy prime minister said data centres should be built away from residents and supply their own power and water. The government plans mandatory standards for large AI data centres early next year, while Nationals leader Matt Canavan criticised the approach.

items.title: Chalmers and Taylor clash over productivity inquiry scope
items.summary: Treasurer Jim Chalmers ruled tax and industrial relations settings out of a Productivity Commission inquiry. Opposition Leader Angus Taylor argued capital gains tax discount and negative gearing settings should be examined.

items.title: Nationals under pressure from One Nation
items.summary: Analysis describes the Nationals fighting to survive as One Nation gains support, particularly in New South Wales. Matt Canavan is expected to be favoured in the Queensland seat of Capricornia if he moves to the House.

items.title: Independent MP Helen Haines now in stable condition
items.summary: The Indi MP's condition has improved to stable after she was allegedly struck by a car in Wangaratta on 19 October. Her injuries were life-threatening, and a man has been charged.

india.error: Searches returned no verifiable India news dated within the last 48 hours.

items.title: NDA ahead in Greater Visakhapatnam civic poll count
items.summary: Counting began on 3 November after polling on 1 November, and the NDA was reported to have won over 70 wards. The final tally was not confirmed.

items.title: TDP-led NDA sweeps Andhra civic polls; Jagan alleges rigging
items.summary: Reports say the NDA won most urban local bodies, with Chief Minister Naidu crediting government performance. YSRCP leader Jagan Mohan Reddy alleged the polls were rigged; a statewide tally was not verified.

items.title: TDP breaches YSRCP bastion in Pulivendula municipality
items.summary: The NDA won the Kadapa-district municipality, historically a YSRCP stronghold. Clashes and intimidation allegations were reported there.

items.title: Ram Mohan Naidu meets new civic chairpersons in Srikakulam
items.summary: The Union civil aviation minister met newly elected Ichchapuram and Palasa-Kasibugga chairpersons on 6 November. He stressed drinking water, roads and drainage as priorities.

items.title: Parliament passed AP Reorganisation (Amendment) Bill affirming Amaravati as capital
items.summary: Older story from April 2026 included as background because little newer state-level coverage was found. It affirms Amaravati as the sole capital.

items.title: Nasdaq and S&P 500 rebound, Dow slips after bruising week
items.summary: Tech and chip stocks recovered part of Thursday's sell-off, which pushed the Nasdaq into correction territory. Doubts about the AI boom, partly tied to midterm results, remain.

items.title: October payrolls beat forecasts at 165,000
items.summary: Employment rose by 165,000 against about 59,000 expected, and unemployment held at 4.1%. Strong data keeps rate and bond-yield worries alive.

items.title: Thursday's AI rout ranks among the sharpest in months
items.summary: Reports put Thursday's Nasdaq fall above 5%, its steepest daily drop in about 19 months. Next week's direction depends on whether the rebound holds.

items.title: ASX slips as Wall Street AI sell-off follows US election rally
items.summary: The ASX 200 lost 44.3 points on Friday but still gained 1.27% for the week. Materials fell 2.51% while consumer staples rose 1.41% and financials 0.55%.

items.title: Sims, South32 fall while Coles, Woolworths and NAB gain
items.summary: Sims dropped 7.22% to $19.65, while Coles rose to $22.60 and NAB gained 2.67% to $40.00. Qantas flagged higher fares and flight cuts as fuel costs rise.

items.title: ASX 200 ends Friday at 9,020.8 after global tech sell-off
items.summary: The local market's light tech exposure muted the impact of the US sell-off. AUD/USD and futures levels were not available; markets are closed today.

items.title: Auction clearance rates hit multi-year lows
items.summary: One report put the combined-capitals preliminary rate at 47.2%, the lowest since April 2020, with volumes thin before the Melbourne Cup. Another cited Cotality at 43.6% with Sydney at 41.7%, so figures conflict by source and week.

items.title: RBA hike smashes the auction market
items.summary: Rate rises this year are weighing heavily on auction results. The piece is from October and is the latest of its type found.

items.title: RBA November preview: hike to 4.85% base case for investors
items.summary: Previews expected a further 25 basis point rise, lifting repayments for borrowers. Single-source reports say the hike happened on 3 November.

items.title: Buyers urged not to wait as major cities post weakest clearance rates this year
items.summary: Weak clearance rates in the big cities are prompting advice to avoid waiting for lower prices. Date not confirmed, so treat as recent background.

items.title: Auction clearance rate sinks to three-month low as Sydney and Melbourne drag
items.summary: Older story from 5 October, included because it sets the trend: clearance rates fell below 50% as the two biggest markets weakened.
